scope: Measured same-season reconstruction. Known game appearances/starters/minute totals retained. Source phase/pair profiles exclude tested game fold. Timing is a statistical plan, not exact target-game substitution replay.
remainingWork: Residual per-game source timing/overlap differences are expected and reported.
Emergency minimum-five foul-exhaustion retains the existing engine fallback; technical-foul penalties for that rare case are not newly implemented.
Overtime retains the existing heuristic; actual minute errors include differences in actual versus simulated overtime duration.
Player offense/defense calibration must be assessed on the corrected rotation; no automatic OVR or game preset promotion.
Payton/Curry overlap remains below source; source pair targets are not exactly realized by the online controller.
Short playing segments remain more frequent than source; the duration distribution is reported, not declared fully accurate.
Guard/big role coverage currently uses positions and a height fallback; flexible small-ball role recognition remains limited.
